name: Authority OS — Command Reference
description: Quick reference for all CLI commands available in this framework. Use these with your AI agent or run them directly in a terminal.

commands.name: execute_test_suite
commands.description: Runs the full test suite across all browsers.

commands.name: run_smoke_tests
commands.description: Runs only tests tagged @smoke — the critical business path.

commands.name: run_specific_test
commands.description: Runs a single test file. Replace <file> with the path.

commands.name: analyze_logs
commands.description: Opens the last trace for failure analysis.

commands.name: generate_report
commands.description: Generates and opens the Allure report from the last run.
commands.run: npm run report:generate && npm run report:open

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Runs ESLint across the entire codebase.
